_readme: Things I've made. `status` is one of NOW, LIVE, NEW, PARKED, RETIRED (it becomes the rubber stamp). `body` is Markdown and optional.

items.title: My startup
items.summary: My first startup, a small brand I run from Hyderabad. I do most of it myself: the product, the packaging, the website, the shipping and the customer inbox.
items.body: I started it with my friend Vineeth Kumar Duggepogu. We met at a job interview in Hyderabad and later worked together at Zomato Everyday.

items.title: A website I built
items.summary: My startup’s store, built with AI coding tools: plain pages on Cloudflare, a checkout, shipping, a help desk, and a phone app that rings when an order comes in.
items.body: No framework. Most of what I know about websites I learned by breaking this one and fixing it again.

items.title: This site
items.summary: A photocopied zine about me, made the same way: static pages, no framework, no trackers.
